issues.description: TLS 1.0 in use (deprecated, vulnerable to POODLE/BEAST)
STARTTLS advertised but plaintext fallback possible (downgrade risk)

servers.recommendation: Upgrade to TLS 1.2+ minimum (prefer 1.3), renew certificate immediately, disable RC4 and other weak ciphers, enforce STARTTLS with no plaintext fallback.

issues.description: No post-quantum key exchange support yet (not yet critical, but worth planning for)

servers.recommendation: Current configuration follows best practice (TLS 1.3, valid certificate, strong ciphers). Consider evaluating post-quantum-ready cipher suites for future-proofing.

issues.description: Self-signed certificate not trusted by standard CAs

servers.recommendation: Replace with a CA-signed certificate and upgrade minimum TLS version to 1.2+.

issues.description: One moderately weak cipher suite still enabled alongside strong ones

servers.recommendation: Remove the moderately weak cipher suite from the server's allowed list; keep only strong, modern ciphers.

issues.description: No TLS/SSL support detected at all - fully plaintext

servers.recommendation: Enable POP3S (port 995) immediately or enforce STARTTLS; plaintext credential transmission is an urgent, critical fix.
